title: hardenbergia monophylla var. alba
intro: Hardenbergia monophylla var. alba, commonly known as White Coral Pea or White Native Violet, is a flowering plant native to Australia. It is used for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure, improve heart health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hardenbergia monophylla var. alba include vasodilatation, which helps to reduce blood pressure, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
